reviews.text:
I've just returned to Portugal after a few years abroad, and I chose the **CVS SOS Animal in Telheiras** not only for its veterinary services, but also because I already knew and followed their work through Instagram. Over time, I had already contributed to this cause, both through in-kind donations and monetary contributions. Therefore, now that I'm back, it made perfect sense to become a member and also start taking my dog ​​to this clinic.

From the very first moment, I was extremely well received by the entire team. The service is warm, attentive, and very humane. During the consultation, I felt genuine care and dedication: there's time to listen, observe the animal, and above all, for the veterinarian to calmly explain the whole situation and clarify all doubts, without that feeling of a rushed consultation.

My dog ​​was treated with enormous care and affection, and I felt confident from the start. Beyond the quality of veterinary care, I also consider it very important to know that we are contributing to such a necessary cause as animal welfare and the promotion of responsible adoptions.

The prices are also accessible and balanced compared to those practiced in the market, which makes this project even more meritorious.

For me, it is my veterinary clinic of choice in Lisbon and, simultaneously, one of my favorite options when I want to contribute to animal welfare. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for good veterinary care, but also to anyone who wants to support a cause where animals are truly at the center.
I love it, I wish there was a 24-hour hospital at the clinic.

They are a wonderful team, they are not exempt from mistakes because they are human, animals never make mistakes, but sometimes they cross paths with the wrong human and when that happens SOS Animal is there for them, to give them a new opportunity, a new life, with someone who truly loves them.
The way they welcome, care for and love animals makes them people with importance and meaning. Our story is over 15 years old, when I took a little dog I rescued from the street in very bad condition (I named her Turner in honor of Tina Turner, a very strong and resilient woman) and they were so kind to me and to the dog's story that I was able to take the right steps and give her a good home and a good family, then life went on, I continued to take my animals there and so your team gave me some of the best moments of my life and was with me in the worst, when I lost my Brooklyn and my Texas (forever Nata), I always saw the team (the current one and all those who were). (leaving) as family, a family that respects, listens and gives affection. Thank you to the whole team for everything.
They never answer the phone! Impossible to get through.
Amazing professionals. Dr. Sofia is super attentive and kind to our little one. We really appreciated all the care from the clinic's professionals. Thank you so much.

They came into my life at a desperate time; my dog ​​was extremely ill and wouldn't eat. I met them through a colleague's recommendation. From the first contact, they were amazing—super understanding, concerned, kind, and helpful. My dog ​​had a thrombosis in her spleen. After two weeks of follow-up with them, we scheduled the operation, and it was a success. The post-operative period went beautifully, and almost two months later, I'm here to share my experience. They saved my dog's life; a simple thank you is not enough for the role they played. Thank you and until next time ❤️ Here are some photos of Kika and a before-and-after of the healing process. Kisses 😘

Complete confidence in all the professionals. Tilly is 6 years old and has always been cared for at SOS Animal. I recommend them; they are very helpful and caring with the animals. They always call to remind us of vaccination dates and, when there is an emergency, they always call the following days to check on the situation.
Adopted the most lovely dog from SOS Animal, who they rescued and fully treated before, and now go there regularly for routine visits. Super kind staff, very organized and professional.

Solidarity only for their own pockets, as they don't even bother with the state, nor do they issue invoices even when requested. It must be the vet's rarest practice. DISGUSTING!

------

Last week, and ever since, they haven't issued invoices! I went there 2 years ago and it was exactly the same. And if they do issue them later, why don't they keep the data to invoice later and send it? Hmm, strange, isn't it? How can I have an invoice if that's exactly the issue!? They didn't give me anything, they only gave me the ATM to pay. And it wasn't an employee who attended me, it was the owner herself, who appears on the television program, and she was the one who told me they were working without invoices. Especially since I couldn't have been informed of this situation by the person who attended me because the doctor didn't even speak Portuguese.

Maybe they should think better before responding to comments.
Wonderful service. Super attentive. I highly recommend them!

They are not at all compassionate.
The prices they charge, despite the annual fee, are not cheap at all; they charge for everything and more, from toothpaste to flea products that weren't even requested, and they don't inform you during the consultation that they will charge for them.
They are not very friendly, and I doubt their competence and diagnostic and assessment skills.
They are, in fact, a money-making machine.

I tried calling and spent 27 minutes listening to a cassette telling me to wait because they are doing everything possible to answer my call!!!!!!

Thank you very much, I will try again tomorrow.

The staff is very friendly and dedicated. I've had to go to the SOS Animal Solidarity Veterinary Hospital several times for various reasons, and we've always received excellent care. Our animals, well... they love the pampering from the receptionists. :)
The whole experience was positive and I am especially grateful for the great care they took in looking after my senior dog, who hates visits to the vet and doesn't cooperate at all.

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire clinic team.

I arrived at a moment of great urgency and emotional fragility, with my cat in critical condition and very limited resources. From the first contact, I felt empathy, professionalism, and genuine care—both for my cat and for me as her owner.

The team always explained the options clearly and honestly, taking into account the clinical reality but also my situation, which demonstrated enormous sensitivity and humanity. Even when the outcome wasn't what we all hoped for, I was left with the certainty that everything possible and ethically correct was done, with respect and compassion.

In one of the most difficult moments of my life, I found professionals who treat animals like family. Therefore, I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic.

Thank you for everything you did for Neguinha.
It's difficult to find veterinarians who are up to the task... and there aren't any here.
Hello, I'm Margarida and I asked Animal Life for help, but because I'm 12 years old, I was refused assistance even though my owner met all the requirements to receive help.
SOS ANIMAL is an institution with a super professional and humane team. I would like to give special praise to Dr. Carina Marta. Thank you very much and well done 💜🙏💜 …
My cats have been treated at this hospital for 8 years and I have the highest opinion of them. Responsible, caring and very competent professionals! They also actively contribute to animal welfare!!
Thank you so much for everything.

Letter of thanks to the CVS SOS Animal team
To all of you, without exception, all of this is due to your professionalism.
CVS SOS Animal Team,

I want to express my deepest gratitude to the entire team for the incredible support and care you gave to my beloved dog Pipa. The help and affection you provided were fundamental to her well-being and I am eternally grateful.
The way each member of the team dedicated themselves and worked to ensure that Pipa received the best possible treatment is truly inspiring. The compassion, competence and attention to detail shown by everyone were remarkable.
Please accept my sincere thanks for everything you did for Pipa. You not only took care of her but also gave me peace of mind and support during a difficult time. I am very grateful to have a team like CVS SOS Animal that genuinely cares about animals and their families.
Thank you again for all the care and love dedicated to Pipa.
I hope you continue to do good for so many animals in need.
And to the clinic's management, thank you very much for the professionals at the clinic.

Congratulations Dr. Sandra Duarte Cardoso for the competent clinical team.

With my best regards, Sofia Lá-Salete, Pipa Correia Pires's guardian.

I recommend this clinic without a doubt!

My Chica Sissi has reached 18 and a half years old largely thanks to Dr. Carina. She's been coming here for about 6 years.

She's had two cancers (both eradicated so far), one in her breast and another between her head and neck. She has a skin problem that is being monitored, as well as two bone spurs on her spine. She's had tartar buildup and is obese.

And... she's doing great and is strong! The doctor is thoughtful, accurate, gentle, and competent. She explains things well and always considers all options, always putting the animal's happiness first.

The cat underwent ozone therapy (bagging) with the specialist doctor for her skin problem, and it has been consistently effective!

The price is discounted for members.

Thank you so much for your work!

This kind of place is deplorable; an organization that claims to defend and protect animals is ultimately only interested in money, and the animals and their care are often overlooked. I went with my elderly and sick cat, who has cancer, to get a second opinion, and they tried to charge me for three years' membership fees that I hadn't used. I stopped being a member, and at the time, nobody informed me that I had to request a written "cancellation." I took my sick cat out of the house specifically to go there, and that's when they informed me of this, even though they could have told me over the phone since I had specified that I had been there before. It's deplorable; they only cared about the money and nothing else. I don't advise anyone to go there.
